senses.gloss:
शव् शव् (perhaps originally शु, and con-
nected with rt. श्वि, ‘to swell, increase,’
in the same way as rt. हु with rt. ह्वे), cl. 1. P.
शवति, &c., to go, approach, (शवति is enumerated
among the गति-कर्माणः in Naigh. II. 14. and
among the परिचरण-कर्माणः according to
some readings in Naigh. III. 5); to alter, change,
transform, corrupt, cause to decay.

शव, अस्, अम्, m. n. a dead body, corpse; (अम्),
n. water.
—शव-काम्य, अस्, m. ‘desirous of dead
bodies,’ a dog.
—शव-दाह, अस्, m. burning a
corpse, cremation of a dead body.
—शव-दाहक,
अस्, or शव-दाहिन्, ई, m. a corpse-burner.
—शव-
भस्मन्, अ, n. the ashes of a corpse.
—शव-भूत,
अस्, आ, अम्, become a corpse or like a corpse.
—शव-
यान, अम्, n. or शव-रथ, अस्, m. ‘corpse-vehicle,’
a bier, hearse, litter for carrying a dead body.
—शव-
वाहक, अस्, m. a corpse-carrier.
—शव-साधन,
अम्, n. ‘corpse-rite,’ a magical and superstitious
ceremony performed with a dead body.
—शव-
स्पर्श, अस्, m. touching a corpse.
—शव-स्पृश्, क्,
क्, क्, one who has touched a corpse (and is conse-
quently defiled).
—शवाच्छादन (˚व-आच्˚), अम्,
ई, n. f. the covering of a corpse, a shroud.

शाव शाव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. शव), cadaverous,
relating to a dead body, produced by or belonging
to a corpse; dead; of a cadaverous or dark yellowish
colour, tawny; relating to purification from the de-
filement caused by contact with a corpse or the death
[]
of a relation; (अस्), m. a dark yellowish or tawny
colour; the young of any animal, (in this sense pro-
bably connected with rt. श्वि, cf. शिशु.)
—शावाशौच
(˚व-अश्˚), अम्, n. impurity caused by contact with
a dead body or by the death of a relation.

सव 1. सव, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 3. सु), pressing
out or extracting the Soma juice; a libation, obla-
tion, sacrifice; N. of the fifth book of the Śata-
patha-Brāhmaṇa; (अम्), n. sprinkling or pouring
out the juice of the Soma plant; making libations;
water; the juice or honey of flowers.

सव 2. सव, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 4. सु), a gene-
rator; the sun; the moon; offspring, progeny.

साव साव, अस्, m. (fr. 1. सव), a libation,
in प्रातः-साव, q. v.

शवर, अस्, m. (said to be fr. शव, cf. शबर), a
barbarian, savage, mountaineer, a Kirāta, (especially
[]
one wearing peacocks’ feathers as a decoration); water;
the hand; N. of Śiva; a particular Śāstra or sacred
treatise; (ई), f. a Śavara female.
—शवर-लोध्र,
अस्, m. the white Lodhra or Lodh tree.
—शवर-
स्वामिन्, see शबर-स्˚.
—शवराल (˚र-आल for
आलय?), अस्, m. a sort of Lodhra or Lodh tree.
—शवरालय (˚र-आल्˚) or शवरावास (˚र-आव्˚),
अस्, m. the abode of outcasts or of wild barbarous
tribes.

शावर शावर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. शवर), relat-
ing to a savage or barbarian, barbarous; low, vile;
(अस्), m. fault, offence; sin, wickedness; the Lodh
tree, = लोध्र; (ई), f. cowach, Carpopogon Pruriens;
a sort of Prākṛt, (one of the five Vibhāṣās, said
to be that spoken by the Śavaras.)
—शावर-
भाष्य, see शाबर-भ्˚.
—शावर-भेदाख्य
(˚द-आख्˚), अम्, n. copper.
—शावरोत्सव (˚र-
उत्˚), अस्, m. a festival observed by savage or bar-
barous tribes.

सवर सवर, अस्, m. (= शवर), water;
N. of Śiva.

सावर सावर, अस्, m. (= शावर), fault, of-
fence; sin, wickedness, crime; the Lodhra tree.

शवल, अस्, आ, अम् (also written शबल), varie-
gated, of a variegated colour, brindled, mottled (with
various hues, as with brown or yellow, &c.),
spotted (applied in Ṛg-veda X. 14, 10. to the
two four-eyed watch-dogs of Yama; the word श-
बल being thought by some to be a corruption
of शर्वर or शर्बर = Κέρβερος); diversified,
varied, divided into various parts; articulate, imi-
tative; (अस्), m. a variegated colour; (आ or ई), f. a
brindled or spotted cow; the cow of plenty, Kāma-
dhenu [cf. शबली]; (अम्), n. water; a religious
observance peculiar to the Bauddhas.
—शवल-गु,
उस्, उस्, उ, having mottled cows.
—शवल-ता, f. or
शवल-त्व, अम्, n. variegation, variety of colour;
variation, alternation.
—शवली-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्,
made of a variegated colour, variegated.

सवल सवल, अस्, m., N. of a king of
Puṣkara (son of Priya-vrata; also written सवन).
—सवलाश्व (˚ल-अश्˚), आस्, m. pl. (perhaps for श-
वलाश्व), epithet of the thousand sons of Dakṣa.

शवसा-वत्, आन्, m., Ved. ‘powerful,’ epithet of
Indra.

शवसिन्, ई, इनी, इ, powerful, mighty, (Sāy. =
बल-वत्.)

शविष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. strongest, most
powerful.
शावक, अस्, m. the young of any animal.

सावक सावक, अस्, इका, अम् (fr. the Caus.
of rt. 4. सु), generative, productive, causing birth,
&c., obstetric, parturient; the young of any animal
(in this sense for शावक); (इका), f. a midwife.
शावसायन, अस्, m. a proper N.

1. सवन, अम्, n. the act of extracting or pouring
out the juice of the Soma plant; a libation; a sacri-
fice or oblation (in general); drinking the Soma
juice; bathing (as a religious exercise or as prepara-
tory to a sacrifice; generally performed three times
a day, viz. morning, mid-day, and evening; cf. त्रि-
षवण); any purificatory ablution; (अस्), m., N.
of a son of Vasiṣṭha.
—सवन-कर्मन्, अ, n.
a sacrificial rite.

2. सवन, अम्, n. the act of bearing children,
bringing forth young, generation.

सावन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 1. सवन), relating to or
comprising the three Savanas; (अस्), m. an institutor
of a sacrifice or employer of priests at a sacrifice
[]
(= यजमान); the conclusion of a sacrifice or the
ceremonies by which it is terminated; N. of Varuṇa;
a month of thirty solar days; a particular kind of
day; a natural or civil day from sunrise to sunset; a
particular kind of year (as distinguished from the
solar year); a particular ceremony performed during
the Sāvana month.

सवितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, generating, vivifying, pro-
ducing, causing, effecting; (ता), m. a generator,
vivifier; the sun, (in the Veda sometimes identified
with and sometimes distinguished from Sūrya, q. v.;
according to Sāy. the sun before rising is called
Savitṛ, and after rising till its setting Sūrya; many
hymns of the Ṛg-veda are devoted to the praise of
Savitṛ, e. g. 1. 35, II. 38, III. 62, 10-12, IV. 53,
54, V. 81, 82, &c.; he is described as ‘golden-
eyed,’ ‘golden-handed,’ ‘golden-armed,’ ‘golden-
tongued,’ ‘yellow-haired,’ &c., the waters and the
winds are said to obey him, and the other gods are
described as following his lead and bowing to his
authority; he is also, like Agni, called Apāṃ napāt,
‘son of the waters,’ and is even worshipped as a
‘lord of all creatures,’ supporting the world and de-
livering his votaries from sin; the celebrated verse
called गायत्री and सावित्री, q. q. v. v., is addressed to
him); epithet of Indra; of Śiva; N. of one of the
twenty-eight Vyāsas; a particular plant or tree
(= अर्क); (त्री), f. a mother; a cow.
—सवितृ-
दैवत, अस्, m. ‘having the sun for a deity,’ the
constellation Hastā or the thirteenth of the lunar
asterisms (so called because the sun is the ruling
deity of this asterism).
सवितृ सवितृ. See col. 2.

सवितृल, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging or relating to
the sun, solar.

सवित्र, अम्, n. a cause of generation, instrument
of production.

सावित्र सावित्र, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. सवितृ), re-
lating or belonging to the sun; descended from the
sun, belonging to the solar dynasty; accompanied by
the Gāyatrī (or sacred verse described below); (अस्),
m. the sun; an embryo or fetus; a Brāhman; N.
of Śiva; of Karṇa (as child of the Sun); of a Vasu,
q. v.; of the tenth Kalpa (according to the Vāyu-
Purāṇa); of one of the Nakṣatras or lunar aste-
risms; (ई), f. a beam or ray of light, a cluster of solar
rays; N. of a celebrated verse of the Ṛg-veda (III.
62, 10. regarded as the most sacred verse of the
Veda, and called Sāvitrī as addressed to the sun; it
is repeated by every Brāhman at his morning and
evening devotions, and is also called गायत्री, see
under गायत्र, p. 288); N. of a wife of Brahmā
(sometimes regarded as the above verse or prayer
deified and represented as mystical mother of the
first three twice-born classes; sometimes identified
with the daughter of Savitṛ by his wife Pṛśni); the
ceremony of investiture with the sacred thread, (see
उप-नय, p. 164, col. 3); a kind of metre; epithet
of Sūryā (daughter of Savitṛ); of Umā (wife of
Śiva); of a daughter of Dakṣa (wife of Dharma);
of the wife of Kaśyapa; of the wife of Satya-vat
(king of Śālva; she was daughter of Aśva-pati, king
of Madra); (अम्), n. the sacred sacrificial thread
worn only by Brāhmans and members of the first
three classes, (see यज्ञोपवीत; it was called Sā-
vitra because the repetition of the Gāyatrī forms
part of the ceremony of investiture.)
—सावित्री-तीर्थ,
अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha.
—सावित्री-पतित or सावित्री-
परिभ्रष्ट, अस्, m. ‘fallen from the Sāvitrī,’ a
man of one of the first three classes not invested at
the proper time with the sacrificial cord.
—सावित्री-
महानाम्य, (according to some) the ceremony of
investiture accompanied by repetition of the Gāyatrī.
—सावित्री-व्रत, अम्, n. a particular fast (kept by
Hindū women on the fourteenth day of the second half
of the month Vaiśākha, or of the dark half of Jyaiṣṭha,
to preserve them from widowhood).
—सावित्री-सूत्र,
अम्, n. the sacred cord or thread worn by men of
the three twice-born classes, (see above.)
—सावित्र्य्-
अवरजा, f. the younger daughter of Sāvitrī.

सवित्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating or belonging to
the sun, solar.
सवित्री, f., see under सवितृ above.

सवीमन्, आ, m., Ved. production, generation,
vivifying power, favouring aid.
सवीमन् सवीमन्. See under 2. सव.

सवज्रसङ्घात स-वज्र-सङ्घात, अस्, आ, अम्,
with the stroke of a thunderbolt.

सवत्स स-वत्स, अस्, आ, अम्, together with
a calf, having a calf; having descendants.

सवधूक स-वधूक, अस्, m. along with a
wife, a man with his wife.

सवपुष स-वपुष, अस्, ई, अम्, having a body
or form, embodied.

सवयस् स-वयस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, being of the
same age, coeval, cotemporary; (आस्), m. a coeval,
cotemporary, friend of the same age; (आस्), f. a
woman's female friend or confidante.

सवरूथ स-वरूथ, अस्, आ, अम्, having a
protecting ledge, (see वरूथ.)

सवर्ण स-वर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, being of the
same colour; being of like appearance, like, resem-
bling; of the same tribe or class; belonging to the
same class of letters (i. e. uttered by the same organs
of speech); of the same kind, homogeneous; (आ),
f., N. of the woman substituted by Saraṇyū for
herself as a wife of the Sun, (she is said to have
given birth to Manu, and is called in later legends
Chāyā; see सरण्यू); N. of a daughter of the
Ocean, and wife of Prācīna-varhis.
—सवर्णास-
वर्ण-विवाह (˚ण-अस्˚), अस्, m. the marriage of
people of the same and of different castes.
—सवर्-
णोपायिन् (˚णा-उप्˚), ई, m. one who approaches a
woman of the same caste.

सावर्ण सावर्ण, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. स-वर्ण), re-
lating or belonging to one of the same colour or
tribe or caste; (अस्), m. (fr. स-वर्णा), a metronymic
of the eighth Manu, (see below.)
—सावर्ण-लक्-
ष्य, अम्, n. ‘mark of sameness of colour or caste,’
the skin.

स-वर्णि-लिङ्गिन्, ई, इनी, इ, wearing the marks of
a religious student, disguised as a Brahma-cārin, (see
वर्णिन्.)

सवर्मन् स-वर्मन्, आ, आ, अ, having armour,
along with armour.

सवहा स-वहा, f. the plant Tri-vṛt; [cf.
सु-वहा.]

सवाचस् स-वाचस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, or स-वाचस,
अस्, आ, अम्, having words or conversation, conversing
with.

सवाणधि स-वाणधि, इस्, इस्, इ, together with
a quiver, bearing a quiver.

सवालखिल्य स-वालखिल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to-
gether with the Vālakhilya hymns.

सवाष्पस्तम्भम् स-वाष्प-स्तम्भम्, ind.
with suppression of tears.

सवास 1. स-वास, अस्, आ, अम् (see 1. वास),
scented, perfumed.

सवास 2. स-वास, अस्, आ, अम् (see 2. वास),
having a dwelling.

सवासस् स-वासस्, आस्, आस्, अस् [cf. 3. वास],
clothed, dressed.

सविकल्प स-विकल्प, अस्, आ, अम्, admitting
of an alternative or option, optional; admitting of
ambiguity or doubt, doubtful; having distinction,
distinguishing.

स-विकल्पक, अस्, आ, अम्, = स-विकल्प above;
recognising distinctions (e. g. those of subject and
object in the Vedānta phil; opposed to निर्-वि-
कल्पक).

सविकाश स-विकाश, अस्, आ, अम्, possessing
expansion, expanded, extended, extensive.

सविग्रह स-विग्रह, अस्, आ, अम्, having body
or form, embodied; having meaning or import,
meaning, importing.

सवितर्कम् स-वितर्कम्, ind. with reasoning
or thought, thoughtfully.

सविदिश् स-विदिश्, क्, क्, क्, along with the
intermediate quarters.

सविद्य स-विद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, having learn-
ing, learned, wise, versed in science.

सविद्युत्स्तनित स-विद्युत्-स्तनित, अस्, आ, अम्,
accompanied with lightning and thunder.

सविध स-विध, अस्, आ, अम्, of the same
kind or sort; near, proximate.

सविनय स-विनय, अस्, आ, अम्, having good
behaviour or propriety, well-conducted, well-behaved,
modest; (अम्), n. modestly, humbly, respectfully,
graciously.

सविभास स-विभास, अस्, m. ‘having great
lustre,’ epithet of one of the seven suns.

सविभ्रम स-विभ्रम, अस्, आ, अम्, employing
amorous or coquettish glances, coquettish, wanton;
(अम्), ind. coquettishly, playfully, with amorous
action.

सविमर्शम् स-विमर्शम्, ind. thoughtfully,
with consideration or deliberation.

सविलास स-विलास, अस्, आ, अम्, acting co-
quettishly, sportive, playful, wanton, amorous; (अम्),
ind. playfully, coquettishly, with expressive looks.

सविशेष स-विशेष, अस्, आ, अम्, possessing
distinguishing or characteristic qualities; peculiar,
singular, extraordinary; excellent, superior; having
discrimination, discriminating; (अम्), ind. in a special
or peculiar manner, especially, singularly.

स-विशेषक, अस्, इका, अम्, having distinguishing
properties or peculiar qualities; discriminated; (अम्),
n. any distinguishing peculiarity or characteristic.

स-विशेषण, अस्, आ, अम्, possessing distinctions
or peculiarities; distinguished, marked, characterized,
individualized by peculiar marks or properties.

सविशेषतस्, ind. especially, particularly, singu-
larly, excellently.

सविश्रम्भम् स-विश्रम्भम्, ind. with con-
fidence, confidently.

सविषाण स-विषाण, अस्, आ, अम्, possessing
horns or tusks, along with tusks.

सविषादम् स-विषादम्, ind. despondingly,
with despair.

सविस्तर स-विस्तर, अस्, आ, अम्, having dif-
fuseness, diffuse, detailed, complete; (अम्), ind. with
all details, in detail, in extenso.

सविस्मय स-विस्मय, अस्, आ, अम्, astonished,
surprised; doubtful; (अम्), ind. with surprise; with
respect, respectfully.

सविहङ्ग स-विहङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, possessing
birds, with birds.

सवृक्षक्षुपलत स-वृक्ष-क्षुप-लत, अस्, आ,
अम्, having trees, bushes, and creepers.

सवृद्धिक स-वृद्धिक, अस्, आ, अम्, bearing
interest.

सवृध् स-वृध्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. increasing to-
gether, (Sāy. = सह-वर्धयितृ.)

सवेगम् स-वेगम्, ind. with impetuosity,
with great haste, hastily.

सवेणुवीणापणवानुनाद स-वेणु-वीणा-पण-
वानुनाद (˚व-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, resounding with
flutes, lutes, and tabours.

सवेश स-वेश or स-वेष, अस्, आ, अम्, ap-
pareled, dressed, ornamented, decorated; near, prox-
imate.

सवैक्लव्यम् स-वैक्लव्यम्, ind. with bewil-
derment; with despair, despairingly.

सवैलक्ष्य स-वैलक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, having
contrary marks or characteristics, unnatural; abashed,
embarrassed, pretended, forced; (अम्), ind. affectedly.
—सवैलक्ष्य-स्मितम्, ind. with a forced smile.

सव्य सव्य, अस्, आ, अम् (according to Uṇā-
di-s. IV. 109. fr. rt. सू; perhaps for an original
स्कव्य), left, left hand; south, southern; reverse,
contrary, backward; (अस्), m., N. of an Āṅgirasa
(author of the hymns Ṛg-veda 1. 51-57); an epi-
thet of Viṣṇu; [cf. Gr. σκαιό-ςμ σκαιό-τη-ς, σκαιο-
σύνη (probably also σκαῦρο-ς); Lat. scœvu-s, scœ-
vitas, scœvola (perhaps also scauru-s, sinister);
Slav. sui.]
—सव्य-तस्, ind. from the left side; on
the left side, on the left hand; in a reverse way.
—सव्य-ष्ठृ, ठा, m. = सव्ये-ष्ठृ.
—सव्य-
साचिन्, ई, m. (see साचिन्), ‘drawing a bow with the
left hand as well as the right,’ epithet of Arjuna;
any person who can use both hands alike.
—सव्या-
पसव्य (˚य-अप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, left and right, re-
verse and direct, wrong and right.
—सव्येतर
(˚य-इत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, ‘other than left,’ right.
—सव्ये-
ष्ठ, अस्, or सव्ये-ष्ठृ, ठा, m. ‘standing on
the left,’ a charioteer.

सव्यथ स-व्यथ, अस्, आ, अम्, feeling pain
or anguish, suffering pain.

सव्यध स-व्यध, अस्, आ, अम्, having blows,
having wounds.

सव्यपेक्ष स-व्यपेक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, having
connection, connected.

सव्यभिचार स-व्यभिचार, अस्, m. an alleged
reason which goes astray, i. e. a reason or argument
that is incompatible with the conclusion drawn from
it; an allegation that proves too much (one of the
Hetv-ābhāsas, q. v.), a too general middle term (as
‘fire’ to prove smoke).

सव्याज स-व्याज, अस्, आ, अम्, artful, fraudu-
lent; cunning, plausible, pretending; (अम्), ind.
under a pretext or pretence, artfully, cunningly.

सव्यापार स-व्यापार, अस्, आ, अम्, having
employment, employed, occupied, busily engaged.

सव्याहृतिप्रणवक स-व्याहृति-प्रणवक, अस्,
आ, अम्, accompanied with the (three) Vyāhṛtis and
the syllable Om, (see व्य्-आहृति, प्र-णव.)

सव्रीड स-व्रीड, अस्, आ, अम्, feeling shame,
modest, ashamed, bashful; (अम्), ind. with shame,
bashfully.

सावकाश सावकाश (स-अव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, hav-
ing leisure, at leisure; (अम्), ind. leisurely.

सावग्रह सावग्रह (स-अव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, hav-
ing the grammatical mark called Ava-graha, q. v.

सावज्ञ सावज्ञ (स-अव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, feeling
contempt, despising, disdainful.

सावद्य सावद्य (स-अव्˚), अम्, n., scil. ऐश्वर्-
य, one of the three kinds of power attainable by
an ascetic, (the other two are called निर्-अवद्य and
सूक्ष्म.)

सावधान सावधान (स-अव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
having or bestowing attention, attentive, heedful,
careful, cautious; diligent; (अम्), ind. cautiously.
—सावधान-ता, f. attention, carefulness.

सावधानी-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c., to make
careful, caution, put on one's guard.

सावधानी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, cautioned, apprized,
made aware.

सावधारण सावधारण (स-अव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
(in argumentative writings) having a limitation.

सावधि सावधि (स-अव्˚), इस्, इस्, इ, together
with a limit or termination, having a bound or limit,
limited (in time), finite, defined, circumscribed.

सावन्तमिश्र सावन्त-मिश्र, अस्, m. a pro-
per N.

सावयव सावयव (स-अव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, com-
posed of parts (in the Vaiśeṣika phil. said of all
things except the eternal substances).

सावरण सावरण (स-आव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, hav-
ing concealment or secrecy, clandestine.

सावर्णि, इस्, m. a metronymic of the eighth Manu
(son of the Sun by Sa-varṇā, q. v., and therefore
younger brother of the seventh Manu or Vaivasvata;
the succeeding Manus to the twelfth, or according
to other authorities to the fourteenth, inclusive are
also called Sāvarṇi; cf. दक्ष-स्˚, ब्रह्म-स्˚,
धर्म-स्˚); (अयस्), m. pl., N. of a Gotra.

सावर्णिक, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to Sāvarṇi, ar-
ranged by Sāvarṇi (said of a Saṃhitā).

सावलम्ब सावलम्ब (स-अव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
having a support or prop, supported, leaning for sup-
port (on the arm of another).

सावलेप सावलेप (स-अव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, full
of pride, proud; (अम्), ind. insolently, arrogantly,
haughtily.

सावशेष सावशेष (स-अव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, hav-
ing a remainder, leaving a residue or remainder, re-
maining; imperfect, incomplete, unfinished.
—सा-
[]
वशेष-बन्धन, अस्, आ, अम्, having bonds still
remaining, still bound.

सावहेल सावहेल (स-अव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, dis-
dainful, disdaining, despising; (अम्), ind. disdain-
fully, contemptuously.

साविष्कार साविष्कार (स-आव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
having manifestation, manifest; showing off or
making an exhibition of any power or talent, proud,
haughty, arrogant (= साहङ्कार).
सावेतस सावेतस, अस्, m., a proper N.
